title: Source or cut the '80% of maintainers have no GPG key' figure
description: DESIGN.md Flag day 'Scale' and docs/for-kernel-reviewers.md say about 80% of maintainers have no GPG key; no measurement is on record. Measure it: fetch pgpkeys.git (verify the freeze/HEAD commit signature) and linux MAINTAINERS (M: lines, unique emails), count how many maintainer emails appear on an unrevoked UID in pgpkeys. Keep names/emails local; commit only aggregates with method, source commits and date. Replace the figure in DESIGN and the cover note with the measured number, or cut it. Delete fetched data afterwards.
acceptance_criteria: Measured aggregate with method and source commits in DESIGN (or figure removed from both files); no personal data committed; fetched copies deleted.
close_reason: Measured 79.5% (1,538/1,935) of MAINTAINERS people without a pgpkeys key at pgpkeys af88128e, linux 7be4bc52; replaced the 80% figure in DESIGN Flag day Scale and for-kernel-reviewers
